name: Build: wetness on materials, puddles on wet ground
body: Material.wetness (0 to 1) and Material.puddles (0 to 1) reach the lit shader through the unused surface.w and emissive.w slots, so no uniform layout changes. Wet darkens the albedo and lowers roughness; puddles are a world-space noise mask on up-facing surfaces that flattens the normal and drops roughness to a mirror. Nyx: lantern::world::SetWetness(entity, wetness, puddles). One PR with a GPU test, before/after screenshots, a guide page and a decision.
